chara_info.detail: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

skills.name: Frostglint from Afar
skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Pierce of the Ice Fog
skills.desc: Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler. Frostpierce Star · Follows your party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. · When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} (max 8 stacks). · When not in combat, {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} expires after 30s. You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.

skills.name: Frostbound Javelin
skills.desc: Generates ice javelins with the power of Cryo, then directs them at the enemy to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG. When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK}, which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased. Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type. Feel the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.

passives.name: Ever-Keen Frost
passives.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.

passives.name: Lucent Ice
passives.desc: The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.

passives.name: Illusory Frostmirror
passives.desc: The Traveler will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> state for 8s when they are inside a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> or trigger a Stellar Swirl reaction respectively.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.

constellations.name: Somber Freeze
constellations.desc: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

constellations.name: Frostfall Reverberation
constellations.desc: The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color>.\nAdditionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

constellations.name: Glacial Shard
constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Frostbound Javelin</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Enduring Ice
constellations.desc: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> is increased by 25%.

constellations.name: Bittercold Fog
constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Pierce of the Ice Fog</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Brumal Grimfrost
constellations.desc: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Frostbound Javelin</color> increases Stellar Glimmer DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
